# MagnetController

> Snap elements toward each other or to a grid when dragged within a threshold distance.

## Constructor

```ts
new MagnetController(host: HTMLElement, options?: MagnetOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `selector` | `string` | no | CSS selector for draggable items within host (default ':scope > ') |
| `threshold` | `number` | no | Snap threshold distance in px — how close before snapping (default 20) |
| `gridSize` | `number` | no | Snap to grid size in px — 0 means snap to other elements only (default 0) |
| `strength` | `number` | no | Snap strength 0-1 — how aggressively it pulls (default 0.3) |
| `guides` | `boolean` | no | Show guide lines when snapping (default true) |
| `guideColor` | `string` | no | Guide line color (default 'var(--n-color-accent-500)') |
| `snapToEdges` | `boolean` | no | Enable snap to container edges (default true) |
| `snapToSiblings` | `boolean` | no | Enable snap to sibling element edges/centers (default true) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disable the controller |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:magnet-snap` | `{ item, x, y, snappedTo, axis }` |
| `native:magnet-drop` | `{ item, x, y }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { MagnetController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new MagnetController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
